meta.note: tara = ((transit nakshatra − janma nakshatra) mod 9), 0 = Janma … 8 = Ati-Mitra. THIS TABLE IS THE ONLY DEFINITION of which taras are favourable. It replaces the contradictory hardcoded lists [1,3,5,7,8] and [0,1,3,5,7,8] that previously existed in two places in jyotish_calculator.html. Janma tara is scored as genuinely mixed rather than being forced into either camp.

translations.en: Janma tara — the birth star itself; mixed. Auspicious for personal rites, weak for new undertakings.
translations.hi: जन्म तारा — मिश्र फल। व्यक्तिगत कर्म हेतु शुभ, नवारम्भ हेतु दुर्बल।

rules.interpretation: Authorities differ: some count Janma among the good taras (for one's own samskaras), others exclude it. Scored as mixed so that neither reading is silently imposed.

translations.en: Sampat tara — wealth and increase; the most favourable.
translations.hi: सम्पत् तारा — सम्पत्ति व वृद्धि; सर्वाधिक अनुकूल।

rules.interpretation: The second tara gives gain in whatever is begun.
One of the three inauspicious taras (Vipat, Pratyari, Vadha).
Grants safety and comfort to the undertaking.
Brings resistance and adversaries to what is begun.
The undertaking is carried to completion.

translations.en: Vadha tara — destruction; the worst tara, strongly avoided.

rules.interpretation: The most damaging of the nine taras; classical practice postpones the act.

translations.en: Ati-Mitra (Parama-Mitra) tara — deeply friendly; the most favourable with Sampat.

rules.interpretation: The ninth tara gives the fullest support of the cycle.
